import io, json, sys, os
sys.path[:0]=['/opt/emicro-deps','/workspace/project']
os.chdir('/workspace/project')
import driver

def call(data):
    if isinstance(data,str): data=data.encode()
    buf=io.BytesIO()
    w=driver.Writer(buf, chunk=1<<20)
    driver.run(data,w)
    w.flush()
    raw=buf.getvalue()
    return json.loads(raw), raw

def job(services, events, limits=None):
    L={'images':16,'cells':262144,'units':1024,'contexts':32768,'connections':4096,'packets':32768,'files':8192}
    if limits: L.update(limits)
    return {'services':services,'limits':L,'events':events}

def run_jobs(jobs):
    out,_=call(json.dumps({'jobs':jobs},separators=(',',':')))
    return out

def ev(j):
    r=run_jobs([j])
    assert len(r['results'])==1, r
    res=r['results'][0]
    if 'error' in res: return res
    return res['events']
